name: Ying Wang de Baoguan
source:
The burning courage will strengthen your fight.
The blazing stars will brighten your night.
The piercing winds will sharpen your sight.

For this who never trapped yet never free!
To raise the flame that value beholds.
To fire the shot that shackle relieves.
To pen the end that future unfolds.
To walk the ██ that ████ achieves.

For those who always apart yet always attached!
Tonight——
Be prepared for the next stage!
And be ready for the next choice!

"Coronet of the Sagacious Lord" is a romance FVN represented in the form of dramas. As tiger Qian Lucai, you’ll collaborate with your childhood friends—hyena Yan Liaoliao, border collie Luo Luo'ai, lion Jiang Bolao, and white wolf Ji Ye—to choose the most suitable drama to perform, helping them confront their personal struggles during the performance.

[Edited from [url=https://woofwoofstudio.itch.io/cosl]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
燃烧的勇气会增强你的战斗力。
闪亮的星星将照亮你的夜晚。
刺骨的风会让你的视线变得更加敏锐。

对于这个从未被困却从未自由的人！
点燃价值所见的火焰。
发射那一枪，解除枷锁。
书写未来展开的结局。
行走 ████ 所达到的 ██ 距离。

献给那些永远分开却又永远依恋的人！
今晚——
为下一阶段做好准备！
并为下一个选择做好准备！

《圣王冠》是一部FVN以戏剧形式呈现的言情小说。作为老虎钱鲁菜，你将与儿时的伙伴——鬣狗燕燎燎、边境牧羊犬罗洛艾、狮子姜波老、白狼姬野——合作，选择最适合表演的戏剧，帮助他们在表演中面对个人的挣扎。

[编辑自[url=https://woofwoofstudio.itch.io/cosl]Itch.io[/url]]
